verdict.rationale: The only in-product, data-derived intelligence in the evidence is machine learning-generated risk scores on every authorization (fraud risk, merchant dispute risk, card-testing detection). That is a narrow ML insight on transaction data, not general AI-generated insights or suggestions. The MCP server lets external agents call the API, so it does not deliver insights inside the product. Missing for 10: an in-product AI assistant or insights surface, AI-generated suggestions or recommendations (e.g., on spending controls or budgets), natural-language analysis of card or transaction data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
